canada.title: An eventual Canada-U.S. trade agreement is vital. A deal with Trump? Much less so
canada.summary: What good is a trade deal with a country whose president doesn’t respect trade deals? That’s becoming an increasingly relevant question for Canada as Prime Minister Mark Carney continues trying to negotiate a new economic arrangement with U.S. President Donald Trump.

canada.title: Ahead of 2027 budget, Martinez Ferrada shuffles Montreal executive committee
canada.summary: Just days before unveiling Montreal's 2027 municipal budget, Mayor Soraya Martinez Ferrada has reshuffled the city's executive committee.

canada.title: Bay du Nord offshore oil project off N.L. clears last major regulatory hurdle
canada.summary: Whether or not the Bay du Nord offshore oil project moves ahead is now up to the companies behind it, as the project has secured its last milestone approval from government.

canada.title: Calgary Co-op not taking care of vulnerable employees, family member says
canada.summary: A group of Calgary Co-op employees, many of whom have disabilities, are facing a difficult choice: take fewer hours and less benefits or go on leave. For one Calgary man who’s worked for the company for almost 30 years, neither option is a good one.

canada.title: Man accused of Bailey McCourt’s murder granted psychiatric assessment
canada.summary: Plover's defence lawyer was granted an application request Wednesday for an in-custody psychiatric assessment to examine his mental state at the time of the offence.

canada.title: ‘GTA VI’ actor with Canadian ties says it’s ‘surreal’ to be part of game
canada.summary: Edwina Rai, who appears in the video game as supporting character Katerina Rosselli, said she first auditioned in April 2022 without even knowing what the project was.

canada.title: Trouble in paradise: Edson volleyball players return home after being stranded in Hawaii for 5 days
canada.summary: Getting stuck in Hawaii for a few extra days might sound like a dream, but it turned into a travel headache this week for nearly 30 Alberta teens and their families. They all finally returned home Thursday morning, after being stranded for five days.

canada.title: Ottawa, Ontario and Sault Ste. Marie to invest $265M in port project
canada.summary: Government officials say the Port of Sault Ste. Marie will support trade diversification across Canada while creating up to 2,150 direct jobs and 2,600 indirect jobs.

canada.title: $200K from N.L. going to downtown St. John’s for private security foot patrols
canada.summary: On Thursday Newfoundland and Labrador’s justice minister announced $200,000 in funding to boost safety in downtown St. John’s, which is going towards uniformed foot patrols. Downtown St. John’s chair Jonathan Loder says it will act as a deterrent against crime.

canada.title: They finally had their dream food truck. Then it was repossessed
canada.summary: A family ran their business, LeoMay Fusion, out of a food truck for about a year in rural Nova Scotia until RCMP officers showed up in mid-October and they learned a previous lender was repossessing the vehicle.

canada.title: Province in talks with Quebec-based company about idled Nackawic pulp mill
canada.summary: The AV Group stopped production at its Nackawic pulp mill in early November, but Natural Resources Minister John Herron told the legislature Friday that he’s hopeful the province can find another operator.

canada.title: Ontario fugitive arrested in Winnipeg hours after making most wanted list
canada.summary: An Ontario fugitive wanted in connection with two Toronto-area shootings was arrested in Winnipeg Thursday, less than six hours after being placed on Canada’s most wanted list.

canada.title: N.B. RCMP are investigating preterm fetus remains found in an airport bathroom
canada.summary: Police say they're investigating the circumstances surrounding the discovery of the remains and provided no further details.

canada.title: Dozens gather at Yukon legislature building to protest end of rent control, return of no-cause evictions
canada.summary: About 50 people gathered outside the Jim Smith building in Whitehorse on Thursday, protesting recent amendments to the territory’s Residential Tenancies Act which removed the rent cap and brought back no-cause evictions.

canada.title: NDP leader Claudia Chender challenges Nova Scotia Power’s proposed $1 billion bill to ratepayers
canada.summary: NDP submission argues Nova Scotia Power shareholders should shoulder the costs.

canada.title: B.C. premier to be sworn in, announce cabinet at Government House
canada.summary: Lorne Doerkson will be sworn in on Friday as B.C.'s 38th premier by Lt.-Gov. Wendy Cocchia, alongside his cabinet.

canada.title: Historic guns locked away as RCMP centre set to become next national museum
canada.summary: At the RCMP Heritage Centre in Regina, which is set to become Canada's next national museum, one display case is glaringly empty.

canada.title: Ontario Liberals to select third new leader since 2018
canada.summary: Ontario's Liberal Party will wrap up a long leadership race Saturday, and, they hope, an even longer stretch without a long-term leader.
